title: This Gives AI Agents Their Own Browser 🤯🌐
description:
I discovered Kernel, browser infrastructure built specifically for AI agents and web automation 🤖🌐

Kernel lets developers spin up sandboxed cloud browsers that agents can control and use to interact with real websites. The browsers can be launched on demand, scaled across multiple sessions, and connected to tools like Playwright, Puppeteer, Browser Use, and other agent frameworks.

It also includes features like persistent browser profiles, live browser views, session replays, stealth capabilities, and managed authentication, making it easier to run browser agents in production.

If you're interested in AI agents, browser automation, and computer-use AI, Kernel is definitely worth checking out.
